why: Drops the muzzle offset, so the smoke rises out of the hull rather than out of the barrel. That is not cosmetic: the whole claim is that the GUN cycled, and a cloud centred on the tank says nothing about the weapon. The position is the same point bullets.ts hands a real `fire` event as its flash, so the sim's own muzzle plane is what is being discarded -- and since #536 this is on screen for every shot every tank fires, not only for a flagged player's refusal.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) leaves the MUZZLE, on the barrel centreline -- not the tank
